name: Frostbite
description: A freezing weapon that overwhelms the battlefield by taking movement away rather than outrunning the enemy. Features Freeze [Z] and Blizzard [X].

phases.name: Phase 1: Ice Cube
phases.effects: A tiny piece of frozen matter shaped into a sword. Pale, sparse, almost no particles. Base 4 DMG and 20 HP.

phases.name: Phase 2: Frost
phases.effects: A thin frost layer spreads across the blade, with small ice crystals and faint particles. Base 12 DMG and 50 HP.

phases.name: Phase 3: Chill
phases.effects: More crystals form and a faint cold mist drifts off the blade. Base 40 DMG and 125 HP.

phases.name: Phase 4: Icebound
phases.effects: Thick ice formations encase the blade and the handle frosts over, trailing ice particles on every swing. Base 105 DMG and 500 HP.

phases.name: Phase 5: Frozen
phases.effects: The sword begins freezing the battlefield itself: frost trails, cold mist and frozen impact effects. Base 315 DMG and 1,250 HP.
phases.notification: The world slows in the cold.

phases.name: Phase 6: Glacier
phases.effects: The first major form: a glacier-like blade with heavy ice formations, a thick frost aura and ice shards on impact. Base 860 DMG and 3,250 HP.
phases.notification: The glacier awakens. Everything beneath it will freeze.

phases.name: Phase 7: Shatter
phases.effects: DELIBERATE COLLAPSE. The glacier breaks: a cracked, fragmentary weapon with almost no aura. Unlocks Freeze [Z] — encases enemies in ice for 5s, doubling all damage they take. Base 6 DMG and 40 HP.
phases.notification: ...Crack. Something broke. But not the cold.

phases.name: Phase 8: Permafrost
phases.effects: The ice reforms stronger than before: larger crystals, a strong frost aura, frozen ground effects and floating shards. Base 6,766 DMG and 8,675 HP.
phases.notification: It survived the fracture. Now it remembers.

phases.name: Phase 9: Deep Freeze
phases.effects: The cold becomes oppressive: dense frost mist, large crystals and ice spreading across the ground. Base 15,000 DMG and 16,666 HP.

phases.name: Phase 10: Frozen Wasteland
phases.effects: The sword creates its own frozen environment: massive ice structures, snow, frozen ground and shards constantly forming and breaking. Base 52,000 DMG and 89,000 HP.
phases.notification: There is no warmth left. Only ice.

phases.name: Phase 11: Fracture
phases.effects: DELIBERATE COLLAPSE. Enormous power becomes unstable: large cracks, missing ice sections and a weak frost aura. Unlocks Blizzard [X] — a 5s freezing storm dealing 50% damage every 0.25s and slowing enemies by 15%. Base 1,333 DMG and 3,333 HP.
phases.notification: Too much... Even ice can break. ...But can it melt?

phases.name: Phase 12: Absolute Zero
phases.effects: FINAL TRANSFORMATION: ABSOLUTE ZERO. A glacier made into a weapon — layered translucent ice, constant snow, crystalline structures and frozen ground. Frostbite no longer freezes things; it stops them. Base 165,000 DMG, 366,000 HP and 150 SPD. Freeze.
phases.notification: The cold has no limit. The world has stopped. This is absolute zero.
